hypotheses.E0_edge_intervention_reproduces_native: The native branch matches checkpoint logits to maximum absolute error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.E1_source_features_have_privileged_local: In at least five of eight candidates, feature edges have at least 1.5 times matched-distance random local-operator effect.
hypotheses.E2_source_features_win_sitewise: In at least five candidates, feature-edge local effect exceeds the random-control mean on at least 60 percent of sites.
hypotheses.E3_source_features_have_privileged_downs: In at least four candidates, feature-edge downstream KL is at least 1.5 times matched-distance random KL.
hypotheses.E4_source_features_explain_material_head: In at least four candidates, feature edges account for at least 25 percent of the full-head local-operator effect.
hypotheses.E5_semantic_routing_survives_distance_co: At least four candidates pass both the 1.5 local-effect and 1.5 downstream-KL ratios.
